title: Dukes of Duchesca - Napoli '97
subtitle: Napoli, estate 1997
acknowledgements: Freely inspired by the TV series 'The Dukes of Hazzard'
In memory of the Rock Garden, Via San Giovanni Maggiore Pignatelli 26: a temple of the Neapolitan underground of the 1990s
The city is a stylised Napoli drawn from memory of a street atlas, not a survey
Original soundtrack: a serenade, a tarantella, a 90s dance loop
content_notice: Unofficial homage, not affiliated with the rights holders of the series it nods to. Code, artwork, music and effects are original.

controls.action: Point where to go: the car turns that way and accelerates; let go to slow down for the police
Horn: scares off the scooters nearby
Light a rauto: it goes off two seconds later, drive clear

start_prompt: Press START to hit the road
